rafa — run a plan through the ralph loop, one task per session

Usage:
  rafa <subject> <action> [args] [flags]
  rafa <subject> --help            actions for a subject
  rafa <subject> <action> --help   arguments, flags, examples

Quick start:
  rafa plan create --spec=.rafa/specs/my-feature.md
  rafa loop start --plan=.rafa/plans/PLAN-my-feature.md
  rafa issue list
  rafa pr current
  rafa effort collect
  rafa module list
  rafa agent vendor tdd-guide
  rafa skill check .claude/skills --project=.
  rafa instinct check .rafa/instincts
  rafa release status
  rafa board list
  rafa epic show
  rafa claim release 324
  rafa status
  rafa next
  rafa roadmap
  rafa switch 252
  rafa init
  rafa doctor
  rafa cleanup
  rafa self-update
  rafa usage
  rafa describe --output=json

Subjects:
  plan       create plans from specs; list, show and validate them; read their
             risk and needs 🪙
  loop       start a plan; stop, pause, resume, show and list its sessions 🪙
  issue      the tracker: list, show, create, comment on and move issues; mark
             one ready, unblock it and check its references
  pr         the pull request of a branch: one line, in full or in the browser;
             list, wait on, merge and triage them 🪙
  effort     collect session and commit rows; report per plan; read and repair
             the store: its schema, a copy for testing, migrations, and fixes;
             merge or import another device's store; move an NDJSON store to
             SQLite
  module     list the configured modules; run an action a module provides
  agent      copy an agent definition into the project; list what a session sees
             🪙
  skill      check a skills directory; list each tier; demote and backfill it 🪙
  instinct   check an instincts directory; list, show, flag and promote its
             records
  release    read the release state of the project; settle the waiting fragments
             into a version; tag the commit that set it
  board      list the boards with their owner, epic count, and which is current
             and home
  epic       show one epic's issues as the Roadmap table; create an epic; defer
             or promote it; move an issue to it; close it through the gate or
             cancel it 🪙
  claim      give up this device's claim on an issue; hand it to another store
             or withdraw the offer; accept a handover; take over a stale claim

Commands:
  status, next 🪙, roadmap, switch, init, doctor, cleanup, self-update, usage,
  describe

Global flags:
  --output=json     NDJSON events instead of text (also RAFA_OUTPUT=json)
  --output=events   one rafa· line per loop event (also RAFA_OUTPUT=events)
  -v, --verbose     up to 3 times, or --verbose=N (also RAFA_VERBOSITY=N)
  --version         print "rafa <version>" and exit; typed alone, no short form

🪙  starts Claude Code sessions, which spend your Claude usage
